title: Operating Model — Person T Screening Review
status: Design proposal · synthetic authored example · real implementation and bank approval unverified
legend: Workflow contains work · Rule checks and records · Skill prepares · Human decides · Agent is a conditional candidate

groups.title: Bind query context
groups.note: Rule binds the subject, query and source versions. It adds no query result.

groups.title: Compare identifiers
groups.note: Rule preserves precision and unknowns; Skill prepares cited differences without an identity verdict.

groups.title: Resolve the evidence gap
groups.note: A conditional candidate may plan evidence gathering. Skill drafts the request; a human confirms access and disclosure. Skip this branch if no gap exists.

groups.title: Prepare the review pack
groups.note: Skill prepares facts and unknowns; Rule checks access, citations and current versions. Preparation is not a decision.

groups.title: Human review
groups.note: People retain materiality and disposition. Rule applies a scoped hold. Independent approval applies only where configured.

groups.title: Record the local outcome
groups.note: Rule records an authorised result, recalculates affected coverage and projects remaining conditions. The whole case stays open.

skills.name: Context & Approved Source Retrieval
skills.stops: No access / unavailable / ambiguous subject → named gap, no invented result
skills.kind: deterministic entrypoints; semantic query proposal separately typed
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Claim Extraction
skills.stops: unsupported or conflicting field → abstain / unknown, never populate from general knowledge
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Entity / Attribute / Duplicate Comparison
skills.input: two versioned claim sets + permitted comparison scope
skills.output: similar / different / inconclusive / not_comparable with evidence
skills.stops: missing/partial dates, scripts, aliases → preserve precision; no identity verdict
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Scope & Policy Condition Evaluation
skills.input: approved versioned rules + current scoped facts
skills.boundaries: Only defined rule-derived records through command boundary
skills.stops: missing rules / facts / authority → unknown or review, not LLM policy generation
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Evidence-use & Completeness Checks
skills.output: missing objects, candidate coverage, provenance gaps
skills.boundaries: Draft checks or deterministic findings; not formal sufficiency judgement
skills.stops: missing assessment differs from invalid evidence; empty/failed manifest never passes
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Decision Pack / Explanation / Composition
skills.input: role-filtered facts, unknowns, sources, permitted actions
skills.output: versioned draft pack or explanation with sources
skills.boundaries: Draft only; no approval or external dispatch
skills.stops: unsupported claim / instruction in evidence / revoked access → exclude or pause
skills.kind: semantic; approved template mode is deterministic
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Work Item & Routing
skills.input: validated task intent + scope + assignment catalogue + dependencies
skills.stops: owner unknown → Unassigned; duplicate intent → same logical task
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Client Collaboration
skills.input: allowed gap projection + response options + recipient grant
skills.boundaries: Drafting read-only; actual dispatch requires separate authorised command
skills.stops: unknown recipient or restricted rationale → draft/pause, no leak
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Approved External Operations & Intake
skills.input: validated request, allowlisted endpoint, credential context outside model
skills.boundaries: Explicit typed query or upload; local synthetic adapters in prework
skills.stops: partial/timeout/access failure ≠ no alerts / valid evidence
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: State / Dependency / Readiness Evaluation
skills.input: complete expected manifest + current versions + decisions + holds
skills.output: affected refs, unknown impact, scoped readiness snapshot
skills.boundaries: Derived state only; no granted business authority
skills.stops: stale/unknown/missing manifest/cycle → not ready or explicit error
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Decision / Event / Provenance Recording
skills.input: authorised result/observed event + expected revisions + causation
skills.output: immutable versioned record and permitted projections
skills.stops: stale inputs or absent authority → reject write, preserve draft/history
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

skills.name: Role Projection & Controlled Publication
skills.output: allowed view / notification / per-target publication receipt
skills.boundaries: Projection read-only; transmission separated and authorised
skills.stops: projection denied/revoked → safe exclusion; dispatch fail preserves decision
skills.implementation_evidence_status: Unverified; no model or runtime evaluation

frames.title: Bind the original finding
frames.text: Person T and synthetic record C01 share the original query time and subject version. Identity information is incomplete. No Target-only evidence is added.

frames.title: Compare, preserving unknowns
frames.text: The authored comparison shows a similar name. Person T’s birth date is missing; provider years 1970 / 1971 cannot be treated as a precise contradiction.

frames.title: Stop at the evidence gap
frames.text: Identity context remains insufficient. A scoped request may be prepared, but recipients, disclosure and personal-evidence access need confirmation. Playback creates no task or hold.

frames.title: Give the decision pack to a person
frames.text: Review the original evidence, unknowns, current scope and permitted consequences. Request information, remain unresolved or refer within existing permissions. Next cannot approve.

frames.title: Authored outcome: remains unresolved
frames.text: The existing C-unresolved story records an unresolved local disposition. A reviewed identity-exclusion checkpoint is unavailable. This is an authored outcome, not your decision. Recheck permission, versions and holds before any actual resumption.
frames.status: Authored outcome — not a user decision

frames.title: Local outcome, open conditions
frames.text: Ownership and population are incomplete; EDD applicability is unknown. Legal, Credit and other applicable conditions remain independently open. This finding is not whole-case clearance.
frames.status: Authored outcome — not a user decision

references.title: DFAT — Guide to Australia’s Consolidated List
references.locator: Names, aliases, dates and places of birth, citizenship
references.observation: List records can contain multiple identifiers, aliases and incomplete information.
references.transfer: Preserve multiple values, precision, unknowns and the original record for a purpose-specific comparison.
references.limit: A single attribute difference cannot automatically exclude a match. The Australian list does not establish coverage for every jurisdiction; no real listed person is imported.

references.title: Wolfsberg — Guidance on Sanctions Screening (2019)
references.observation: An alert does not establish risk. Review relevant information, record disposition reasons and make screening scope and configuration explicit.
references.transfer: Separate Population, Run, Finding, Review, Decision and Coverage; prepare evidence for a human decision.
references.limit: The guidance does not directly establish our bank permissions, thresholds, pause scopes or reuse rules.

references.title: ANZ — KYC SecureReply
references.locator: Selected business-customer information-update workflow; entry/save/contributor FAQ
references.observation: The example uses a reference and an OTP to registered contact details for entry. Save and submit are separate, with contributor restrictions on some fields.
references.transfer: Separate official-site entry from locating a request; keep item responses, submission receipts and review states distinct.
references.limit: This is an information-update example, not the complete institutional clearance journey. It does not validate this case’s security level or representative authority.

references.title: HL7 FHIR R5 — Provenance
references.observation: Provenance links a resource version to an activity, participants and source entities.
references.transfer: Link a decision record to its specific input versions, actor and generating activity.
references.limit: The word agent denotes a participant, not an AI Agent. This prototype does not implement FHIR; R4 and R5 remain distinct versions.
